sections.text:
There was a spoiled princess playing with her favorite golden ball near a pond in the palace garden.

Suddenly, the golden ball fell into the deep pool, and the princess began to cry bitterly.

A frog appeared from the water and said: “I will bring you the ball, provided that you allow me to be your friend, eat from your plate, and sleep in your bed.”

The princess agreed immediately because she wanted the ball, but secretly she was disgusted with the frog.

The frog brought the ball, but the princess took it and ran back to the palace without keeping her promise.

In the evening, the frog came to the palace and demanded his rights, so the king (her father) forced her to fulfill her promise because the promises of kings cannot be broken.

The princess had to let the frog share her food, and when she tried to sleep, the frog fell asleep on her pillow.

The princess got angry and threw the frog forcefully against the wall, but as soon as he hit it, the frog turned into a very handsome prince!
The prince told her that an evil witch had turned him into a frog, and that her spell would only be broken if the princess kept her promise.

The princess felt ashamed of her behavior, married the prince, and they lived happily.
